MDG.note: Page covers tax number registration only; no authentication service stated.
No civil register to ID link stated.
No ID enrolment count or share stated.
No ID system operation or ownership stated.
The page asks for a copy of the CIN but does not say the tax register is keyed on or checked against the national ID number.
No national ID system described beyond the CIN being requested as a document.

facts.fact: The Direction Generale des Impots page says applicants for a NIF (taxpayer identification number) fill in an online registration form on NIFONLINE, get a reference, then present originals at their tax office.
